title: omfp workspace keymap
description: <workspace>/.omfp/keymap.json: key bindings of this workspace (UI-210). They apply while it is a window's current workspace, over the default bindings and the daemon's [keymap] entries, one by one in file order: an entry replaces the binding with the same mode and keys, `"command": ""` removes it, any other entry is added. omfp reads the file and never writes it; an invalid one shows its error while the last valid bindings stay. Unknown keys are ignored.

mode.description: normal: the focus is not in a text field; insert: a text field has it; cmdline: the `:` line is open.

keys.description: Key tokens separated by spaces: a printable key is its character (`j`, `G`, `:`), other keys their name (`Space`, `Esc`, `Enter`, `Tab`, `PageDown`, …), prefixed by `Ctrl-`, `Alt-`, `Meta-` (and `Shift-` for non-printable keys), e.g. `g g`, `Space t`, `Ctrl-k`.

command.description: A command id: a built-in one (`:help` lists them) or one a widget registers with `useCommand` (it runs while the widget is shown); "" removes the binding of `keys` in `mode`.
